structuredContent.summary: The PR introduces a diagnostic system for Adblock filter lists, providing real-time status updates and detailed conversion statistics. It implements a polling mechanism in the UI (AdblockFilterListsAdapter and AdblockSettingsFragment) that fetches a JSON snapshot from the native layer via JNI. Key improvements include replacing boolean truncation with jlong counters for download success/failure, providing per-list conversion counts (accepted, rejected, etc.), and displaying manual update outcomes. The architecture maintains a read-only flow where the UI polls a snapshot from the native sidecar. UI lifecycle management (start/stop) is correctly handled to prevent memory leaks or unnecessary polling when the fragment is not visible.
test_gaps: The new `roadium_shields_junit_tests` binary is added to BUILD.gn, but the diff does not show the content of `ShieldsDiagnosticsTest.java`. Ensure it covers all JSON parsing edge cases and null/missing field scenarios.
recommended_changes: Ensure `ShieldsDiagnosticsTest.java` includes tests for malformed JSON and missing optional fields to prevent `NullPointerException` during UI rendering.
